english.title: Without reasonable excuse refuse to answer question to establish qualification to serve as juror
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, refused to answer a question from a senior coroner that appeared necessary to establish whether or not you were qualified to serve as a juror at an inquest
